title: Recover autonomous work through explicit boundaries
summary: Keep exhausted retries visible, replay learning from a durable outbox, and add behavior through validated registries.
hint_triggers: When parent-child rework reaches its limit, retain a blocked state and actionable recovery guidance instead of silently retrying. Persist learning delivery intent before downstream enqueue and support replay after archival. Extend process validation through declared schemas and register Dot extensions atomically so partial registration cannot leak into later work. Verify both failure recovery and unchanged existing behavior at these boundaries.
